selected.prompt: Make a color-only edit of this exact no-text technical drawing. Except scientifically needed class divisions, do not use bright red/orange/cyan or multicolored rainbow. Purewhiteflatbackground, no textures, no gradients, no text or pseudo text. cnn-backprop-shared-overlap exact original canvas 1681×936px.
